title: deployer: pave ses mailbox ops (identity, inbound walk, attachments, roundtrip)
description:
## .what

pave ses mailbox ops for a declared mail stack, generic over its domains + bucket:
- `aws.ses.identity.status.get`: per domain, verified-for-send + dkim status
- `aws.ses.inbound.status.get`: walk the inbound path hop by hop: live mx, ip receipt filters, active receipt rule set (recipients, scan, tls, s3 action), store guards (encryption at rest, public block, bucket policy), newest objects
- `aws.ses.attachment.get`: pull the attachments of one raw inbound object (or the latest) to a gitignored dir
- `aws.ses.roundtrip.prove`: send a nonce probe to the mailbox itself, then read it back

## .why

every ses mailbox owner needs the same four answers: did dns take, where does inbound mail stop, what was attached, does the loop close. prior art (nheuron-specific domains): `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron` `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/mail.{identity.status.get,inbound.status.get,attachment.get,roundtrip.prove}.sh` (main). the inbound walk found a real dropped mail in one run.

## .ask

- take domains + bucket from input or the declared wish, never a hardcoded org
- read-only except the probe send; credentials from keyrack only
- refusal snapshots + gated live cases
